posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
printf command does not print a \n (newline) at the end by default.
Whenever you are printing using printf it prints the number and remains on same line, so the PS4 value (which is + for each level of iteration) gets printed beside the number itself, instead on the next line.
